tests.name: Environment Configuration Model

tests.name: Sanitized Diagnostics Configuration Redaction
tests.expected: Zero admin keys, private keys, or passwords exposed in diagnostics
tests.actual: Diagnostics secret leak detected: false, Redacted: true

tests.name: Startup Validation of Healthy Environment
tests.expected: Healthy configuration passes startup checks with zero critical errors
tests.actual: Valid: true, Critical count: 0

tests.name: Startup Rejection of Unhealthy / Unwritable Environment
tests.command: validateStartupEnvironment with invalid unreachable database path
tests.expected: Fails safely with CRITICAL classification, preventing startup of unhealthy system
tests.actual: Valid: false, Critical errors: 1

tests.name: Database Migration Execution & Deterministic Idempotency
tests.expected: Applied migrations recorded in schema_migrations; second execution applies 0 migrations without error
tests.actual: Run 1: 0 applied, Run 2: 0 applied, Total recorded: 4

tests.name: Migration Tracking Table Integrity

tests.expected: schema_migrations table exists with version tracking
tests.actual: Table exists: true

tests.name: Transactional Rollback Safety on Injected Failure
tests.expected: Atomic transaction rollback leaves zero orphan tenants, owners, or subscriptions

tests.name: Subscription Lifecycle State Machine Transitions

tests.name: Rejection of Illegal Subscription Transitions
